messages:
Diego Morales: hey team, diego here (day 1). opened a tiny docs PR but Buildkite failed on checkout with a 403. i followed onboarding steps, who should i ping for CI access?
Buildkite Bot: Build #721 (diego/docs/fix-typo) failed · exit code 128 · logs: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/721
Diego Morales: checkout error: 
``
remote: HTTP Basic: Access denied
fatal: Authentication failed for 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs.git/'
```
Priya Patel: welcome! :wave: first things: did you accept the org invite and add your SSH key? note that some pipelines use HTTPS with an org deploy token, not personal SSH keys.
Diego Morales: i accepted the invite and added SSH key yesterday. i can clone locally over SSH but Buildkite still errors.
Samir Rao: hi Diego, welcome aboard. sounds like this pipeline uses the org deploy token for HTTPS checkouts and only members of the eng-ci team are covered. i'm adding you to eng-ci and to the Buildkite pipeline team now.
Infra Oncall: FYI the org deploy token rotated on 2024-07-31; users added after that need explicit team membership.
Diego Morales: thanks. re-run now shows a different failure in the setup step: pip install failed with a corrupted wheel: 
``
ERROR: Could not install packages due to an OSError: [Errno 74] corrupted cached wheel
```
Priya Patel: that one is a cache/dockerlayer relic we saw after bumping the base image. Workarounds: re-run with SKIP_PIP_CACHE=1 or use the Buildkite "Clear caches" option on manual run.
Samir Rao: cleared the pipeline cache and re-ran. next attempt failed with a postgres startup timeout in the integration job: 
``
E TimeoutError: Postgres did not start after 60s
```
Marta Nguyen: we've been seeing intermittent slow pulls from the internal registry causing container startup timeouts. quick fixes: set CI_DOCKER_PULL=1, or TAG=ci-latest to force fresh images, or bump job timeout. we also have INC-2024-211 tracking registry slow pulls.
Samir Rao: i added Diego to eng-ci and pipeline teams, cleared caches, and bumped the job timeout to 300s for that pipeline. i also set DOCKER_MAX_RETRIES=3 on the job. re-ran and it progressed further but then a test flaked returning 502 from an internal mock: 
``
E AssertionError: expected 200 but got 502 intermittently
```
Priya Patel: for docs-only changes you can add label "docs-only" or include [ci skip-heavy] in the PR title to skip heavy integration stages. otherwise mark the run manual and set SKIP_MOCKS=1.
Diego Morales: added the docs-only label and re-ran. Buildkite shows green now. thanks so much! build: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/723
Buildkite Bot: Build #723 (diego/docs/fix-typo) passed · duration 6m · https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/723
Diego Morales: saved my first-week panic :relieved: quick Q  for GitHub Actions in other repos, do i need extra permissions to edit workflows?
Priya Patel: you need write access to the repo to push workflow changes. some repos have protected branches or restricted actions, which require a maintainer or admin to approve workflow edits. if you hit a blocked run, ping eng-infra or samir and we'll check repo app installs/permissions.
Samir Rao: if you need the GitHub App installed on a repo you don't own, open a short ticket in #eng-infra and we'll get the app/repo permissions sorted. also good to follow the onboarding CI checklist in the docs so we can mark "CI access" done.
Diego Morales: will do. thanks everyone for the quick help!
